trace_name: UCI Incident Management Process Enriched Event Log — first independent empirical run
trace_source: UCI Machine Learning Repository dataset 498, incident_event_log.csv
entropy_definition: Normalized incident disorder proxy from priority, impact, urgency, active status, reassignment_count, reopen_count, and SLA status.
damaged_repaired_definition: Damaged proxy from increases in disorder/reassignment/reopen/unresolved state; repaired proxy from decreases in disorder and transition toward resolved/closed.
prior_dependency_definition: depends_on references previous event log_id within each incident only; prior_dependency references prior event_id only.
provenance_definition: ticket/incident number is provenance_id and cannot satisfy prior_dependency.
exclusion_rules: Drop incidents with fewer than four ordered records; drop rows without resolvable ordering fields.
claim_boundary: A pass is an empirical evidence candidate for pruning-order recoverability geometry-like closure, not proof of physical geometry, spacetime, GR, ADM, or physical curvature.
